subject: Breeze air purifier keeps dropping off Wi-Fi
body: My Breeze air purifier connects fine for a few hours and then drops off the network. I have to power cycle it to get it back. Router is a fairly new mesh system.
reply: Thanks for the details. Wi-Fi drops on the Breeze air purifier are almost always a 2.4 GHz band-steering issue with mesh routers. Please try these steps: (1) In your router app, create a dedicated 2.4 GHz network or temporarily disable band steering. (2) Hold the reset button on the Breeze air purifier for 10 seconds until the light blinks amber. (3) Set it up again in the app on that 2.4 GHz network. If it still drops after 24 hours, reply with your router model and we will escalate to our network team.

Please try these steps: (1) In your router app, create a dedicated 2.4 GHz network or temporarily disable band steering. (2) Hold the reset button on the Nook speaker for 10 seconds until the light blinks amber. (3) Set it up again in the app on that 2.4 GHz network. If it still drops after 24 hours, reply with your router model and we will escalate to our network team.

subject: Charged twice for Sentry doorbell
body: The invoice for my Sentry doorbell shows a higher total than the price on the checkout page. Looks like tax was applied twice.
reply: Sorry about the confusion with your Sentry doorbell charge. I've looked at the order on our side. When a payment is authorized and then captured, some banks show both as separate pending lines for 2 to 3 business days before the authorization drops off. If both charges are still showing after 3 business days, reply here with the last four digits of the card and the order number and we will refund the duplicate within one business day. Either way, you will only ever be charged once for the Sentry doorbell.

subject: Lumen bulb pack arrived damaged
body: Opened my Lumen bulb pack today and the casing is split. The packaging looked fine from the outside so it must have happened before shipping.
reply: I'm sorry your Lumen bulb pack arrived damaged. We will replace it at no cost. Please reply with a photo of the damage and one of the shipping label so we can file the carrier claim on our side. As soon as we have those, we ship a replacement Lumen bulb pack with a prepaid return label for the damaged unit. You do not need to wait for the return to arrive before the new one ships. Typical turnaround is 2 business days.

subject: App won't show my Nook speaker
body: The app crashes every time I tap on my Nook speaker. Reinstalling didn't help. iPhone, latest iOS.
reply: Thanks for reporting this. We are aware of a sync issue in the current app release that can hide a Nook speaker or show it offline. The fix is in version 4.12.2, which is rolling out now. In the meantime: sign out of the app, force close it, sign back in, and pull down on the device list to refresh. That re-syncs the Nook speaker for most people. If it is still missing after updating to 4.12.2, reply with the email on your account and we will re-link the device from our side.
